title: D4: Planner session rules — restart at 150k context via handover, one notification per wait, no forks, trimmed tool output
spec:
Why: the 2026-09-18 session ran 411 turns to a 446k-token context; 112 monitor notifications were each a full turn; the rules said restart at 60 percent of the window, which is far too late. Text-only change in the Planner's own rules, kept byte-identical where duplicated: CLAUDE.md Always item 9 becomes "At 150k context tokens (or after 150 turns): `uv run orchestrator handover --reason context`, then restart the session on the account `orchestrator pick planner` names." Add to CLAUDE.md Never: "Fork this session or spawn an Agent that inherits its context; spawn fresh workers." Add to both orchestrate SKILL.md copies and skills/planner/resume/SKILL.md: waiting rule (one Monitor per wait with an exit condition on the final state, never per status change; no polling), tool-output rule (head, cut, jq; never cat a file over 200 lines; scout results read once), and the review policy from D1 in one line. Also update the planner-mode text in .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md (C-O3 v3) so the headless Planner carries the same rules. Tests: tests/test_hooks.py (or test_pool.py) asserts the two orchestrate SKILL.md copies are identical and that CLAUDE.md contains the 150k rule.
(Recreated from T-0113: re-pointed at C-O3 v4 and the recreated C-O7b)
acceptance: CLAUDE.md, both orchestrate SKILL.md copies, resume SKILL.md and prompts/planner.md carry the new rules; a test asserts the SKILL.md copies are identical and CLAUDE.md contains '150k'
No other file changed; `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green

result.summary:
Committed clean, working tree is clean.

**Summary:** Updated the Planner's own rules to fix the 411-turn/446k-token session problem: CLAUDE.md and `.orchestrator/prompts/planner.md` now trigger handover at 150k context tokens (or 150 turns) via `orchestrator handover --reason context`, and both files' Never list forbids forking a session or spawning a context-inheriting Agent. Added a "Session hygiene" section (Monitor-per-wait with exit condition/no polling, `head`/`cut`/`jq` over `cat`-ing large files, one-line review policy) to both orchestrate SKILL.md copies (hard-linked, so one edit covers both) and `skills/planner/resume/SKILL.md`.

**Files changed:** `CLAUDE.md`, `.orchestrator/prompts/planner.md`, `skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md` (+ its hard-linked twin `.claude/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md`), `skills/planner/resume/SKILL.md`, `tests/test_hooks.py`.

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` — 236 tests, all green (failures-only output: none).
